lina (partnerships): quick checkwe need a tightened SKU + embargo plan for Q4 hardware on marketplace (H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi). main ask: ops needs slotting + billing needs provisional SKUs by EOD Tue. can we enumerate hard constraints here?
devin (ops): yes. include rack-density and power envelopes per SKU. H100 racks consume more headroom; reserve 2 spare racks for rollback.
jasmin (product): yasmin here 92 product asks marketing: single vendor press or per-model releases? also confirm joint-customer quotes process.
nvidia-bizdev: NVIDIA: H100 GA still targeted w36; embargo: partners request w35-w37. H200 follow-up tranche currently planned w43 with embargo w42-w44. can confirm SKU IDs tomorrow.
amd-ecosystem: AMD: MI300 delivery looks like w45-w47 now. prefer embargo window w44-w46 to leave time for driver docs. driver cert may cause a 3-7 day slip.
gaudi-sysint: Gaudi: silicon slated to reach SI labs w39; initial marketplace exposure after compatibility pass w40-w41. recommend marking Gaudi SKUs as "early-access" until full QA. some early SKUs will be quant-only (8-bit) builds.
raj (infra): infra constraints: image bake and kernel tuning need final SKU tag 72h before canary. provisional tags are fine but must be stable strings. suggest format: rw.market.{vendor}.{model}.prov.v1
devin (ops): ops note: canary pool = 40% first-week capacity reserved for rollback. also need thermal derate notes for H100 power profiles.
annouce-bot: remind: use template https://internal.redwood/announce-templates/joint-vendor-announce-v2 and run marketplace-checklist.
lina (partnerships): i'll sketch a minimal matrix inline then attach to drive. pls paste constraints only (one-line).

```
vendor | model   | announce_week | embargo_window | marketplace_prov_sku                  | ops_notes
NVIDIA | H100    | w36           | w35-w37        | rw.market.nvidia.h100.prov.v1         | high-power, reserve 2 racks, 72h bake
NVIDIA | H200    | w43           | w42-w44        | rw.market.nvidia.h200.prov.v1         | staggered regional ramp
AMD    | MI300   | w46           | w44-w46        | rw.market.amd.mi300.prov.v1           | driver cert may delay, compatibility QA
Gaudi  | B200    | w40-early     | w39-w41        | rw.market.gaudi.b200.earlyaccess.v1   | quant-only builds initially, SI lab pass
Gaudi  | B400    | w42           | w41-w43        | rw.market.gaudi.b400.prov.v1          | higher perf SKU, depends on QA
```

devin (ops): constraints (one-line bullets): 1) 72h bake for image tags; 2) reserve rollback racks; 3) canary pool 40% first week.
raj (infra): kernel tuning/quant libs must ship with image; if vendor kernels arrive late we may fallback to natively quantized builds and delay H200/H400.
yasmin (product): marketing request: if partners want a joint quote, we need customer consent signed during embargo. yasmin will circulate template.
nvidia-bizdev: hard constraint: partner legal won't accept a PR earlier than w35 for H100.
amd-ecosystem: hard constraint: build validation on MI300 cannot be started until we have driver bits in lab. 5-7 business days SLA.
gaudi-sysint: hard constraint: SI compatibility SLA = 10 business days after delivery. early-access SKUs flagged.
lina (partnerships): action items: @nvidia-bizdev confirm SKU names by EOD Mon; @amd-ecosystem confirm driver arrival ETA by Fri; @gaudi-sysint confirm which SKUs are quant-only; @raj provide final provisional SKU naming pattern and confirm 72h bake; @yasmin circulate customer-consent template. i'll post updated matrix to drive and schedule 20m sync Thu.
aya (announce-bot): calendar template: https://internal.redwood/calendar-templates/vendor-announce-sync, include legal + comms.
ysmin (product): +1 include comms and legal on the Thu sync. if anyone can't attend drop hard constraints here.
lina (partnerships): thanks all updating drive now and will ping when matrix is live :raised_hands:
